description: Department of Local Government - Northern Province - Convene the meeting for the election to fill the Vacancy of Vice Chairman of Mannar Pradeshiya Sabha in Northern Province
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the convening of a meeting for the election to fill the vacancy of Vice Chairman of Mannar Pradeshiya Sabha. It falls under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it specifically deals with electoral processes for local authorities, including election scheduling and filling vacancies in elected positions, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
